query:
ALTER TABLE `users`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `phoneVerified` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `userRole` enum('solo_owner','team_lead','executive','operations','other') NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `teamSize` enum('just_me','2_5','6_15','16_plus') NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `inboxChallenge` enum('missing_leads','client_follow_up','too_much_volume','team_coordination') NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `onboardingComplete` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `language` varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `scheduleType` enum('manual','daily_morning','daily_evening','twice_daily','custom') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `scheduleTimes` varchar(255) DEFAULT '08:00',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `timezone` varchar(64) DEFAULT 'America/Chicago',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `toneStyle` enum('concise','conversational','detailed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'conversational',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `keywordsInclude` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `keywordsExclude` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `internationalSms` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `phoneCountryCode` varchar(8) DEFAULT '+1',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialStartedAt` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialEndsAt` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialUsed` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `role` enum('user','admin','owner') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user';
